customItems.name: Broken Oath Seal

treasure.description: Clear blue beryl with oceanlike depth.

customItems.description: An ancient metal sigil, cracked by betrayal and still faintly burning with the vow its bearer failed to keep.

intro.text:
Orren’s directions lead you to a sunken stairway hidden between two leaning stones. The steps descend into a buried hall older than the villages above it.
At the entrance, words are carved into the arch:
Here lie those who swore and failed.
Beyond the arch stretches a long stone hall lined with kneeling statues. Each statue is a knight with its sword laid flat before it. Many have no heads. Others weep streaks of black mineral from their stone eyes.
As your light touches them, iron gauntlets tighten around ancient sword hilts.
A voice rolls through the chamber like a judge passing sentence:

“Who comes before the oathless dead?”

outro.text:
The final oath-seal locks in place with a sound like a chain breaking.
The cursed knight statues fall to one knee. In the silence, the three seals flare with pale fire. You see a vision:
A king in a black-and-gold crown sits upon a stone throne. His own nobles kneel before him. One by one, they swear loyalty.
Then the vision changes.
The same nobles return at night with knives, chains, and a priest carrying a silver funeral mask. They do not kill the king. They bind him beneath the hills.
One knight turns away in shame.
A name burns into your mind:
The Silent Cathedral.

Something shakes you awake. You see Orrens pale face right next to you.
“Is everything alright? I think you blacked out. We need to move on if you really want that crown. I think I can hear them…”

storyTriggers.title: The Door
storyTriggers.text:
A huge buried hall stretches ahead, much wider than the entry. Kneeling knight statues line both walls. Some have no heads. Some have broken swords. Some have shields turned inward toward their own chests.

At the far side stands a sealed exit door with three empty sockets shaped like oath-seals.

It looks like you need to find the matching pieces to get this door to open.
